purpose: visual adjudication of pool-wide near-duplicate candidates that cross an exact-media component boundary; consumed by review_pool_near_duplicates.py to emit the corrected component map
recorded: 2026-08-25, by the reviewing session, from rendered side-by-side pairs
scope: EXAMINED: all 65 crossing candidates clearing foreground correlation 0.6, and all 27 crossing candidates at Hamming 1 or less that the correlation missed, plus a 16-pair sample of the remaining weak band stratified by correlation. NOT EXAMINED: the rest of the weak band. It is unexamined, not clean.

verdicts.duplicate: same subject, scene or catalogue series; becomes a component edge
verdicts.uncertain: could not be told apart at review scale; treated as an edge, because for a split boundary over-joining is the cheaper error
